module.purpose: Provides automatic user locking when rate-limit violations reach a configurable threshold, using Redis to track repeated violations and Prisma to mark users as locked.
module.summary: This module coordinates rate-limit enforcement with temporary Redis counters and persistent user locking. It normalizes identifiers, checks the configured Upstash Redis environment, increments and expires violation counters, and locks users when the threshold is reached. Locking supports numeric user IDs, email addresses, and API keys, while SMS identifiers are intentionally handled elsewhere. API-key lookup failures for missing users are surfaced to callers, whereas other auto-lock processing errors are logged and treated as non-locking failures.
module.businessContext: Supports abuse prevention and account protection across rate-limited workflows and API access. Failure can allow repeated abuse or prevent legitimate users from being locked after sustained violations.

sectionMap.name: configuration guard
sectionMap.intent: Skips auto-lock processing when required Redis environment variables are unavailable.
branchOutcomes: Redis environment missing: log warning and return false

sectionMap.name: identifier normalization
sectionMap.intent: Removes an optional identifier keyword prefix before Redis and database operations.

sectionMap.name: rate-limit violation gate
sectionMap.intent: Processes only unsuccessful rate-limit responses with no remaining allowance.
branchOutcomes: Limit exceeded: read and update auto-lock counter

sectionMap.name: threshold decision
sectionMap.intent: Locks the resolved user when the next violation reaches the configured threshold.
branchOutcomes: Threshold reached: lock user, delete counter, return true
Threshold not reached: update counter and expiry, return false

sectionMap.name: auto-lock error recovery
sectionMap.intent: Rethrows missing API-key users and converts other processing errors into false results.

sectionMap.name: identifier dispatch
sectionMap.intent: Selects the Prisma lookup and update strategy for each supported identifier type.
branchOutcomes: userId: update by numeric user ID
apiKey: hash key, resolve user, then update

sectionMap.name: lock observability
sectionMap.intent: Emits locked-user details only when a user was found and Sentry is configured.
branchOutcomes: User and Sentry DSN present: log lock reason and user details
Otherwise: perform no lock observability logging

invariants.description: Auto-lock counter processing requires both Upstash Redis environment variables.
Violation counters use identifier type, optional keyword, and normalized identifier to isolate tracking keys.
A threshold-reaching violation deletes its Redis counter after successfully locking the user.
Non-threshold violations persist a counter and configure its expiration duration.
Successful rate-limit responses never trigger counter access or user locking.

assumptions.description: Upstash Redis credentials are available when automatic locking is expected to operate.
Prisma exposes user, apiKey, locked, hashedKey, and related selected user fields with the expected schema.
Callers provide a rate-limit response whose success and remaining fields follow RatelimitResponse semantics.
SMS auto-locking is performed by another rate-limit path rather than this function.

moduleContractTests.scenario: A rate-limited request is below the auto-lock threshold.
moduleContractTests.when: handleAutoLock({ identifier: "user@example.com", identifierType: "email", rateLimitResponse: { success: false, remaining: 0 }, autolockThreshold: 5 })
moduleContractTests.then: resolves to false and increments the Redis counter to "3" with an expiry of Math.floor(autolockDuration / 1000)
moduleContractTests.rationale: Pins the counting and expiration behavior before the threshold is reached.

moduleContractTests.scenario: A rate-limited request reaches the configured auto-lock threshold.
moduleContractTests.when: handleAutoLock({ identifier: "user@example.com", identifierType: "email", rateLimitResponse: { success: false, remaining: 0 }, autolockThreshold: 5 })
moduleContractTests.then: resolves to true, locks the user with LockReason.RATE_LIMIT, and deletes lockKey
moduleContractTests.rationale: Guards the threshold boundary and ensures the counter is cleared after locking.

moduleContractTests.scenario: The rate-limit response is successful or still has remaining capacity.
moduleContractTests.when: handleAutoLock({ identifier: "user@example.com", identifierType: "email", rateLimitResponse: { success: true, remaining: 0 } })
moduleContractTests.then: resolves to false without changing Redis or locking the user
moduleContractTests.rationale: Ensures only responses with success === false and remaining <= 0 enter auto-lock counting.
